title.zh: AgnosticUI · 把组件源码拷进项目

description.zh: Accordion 页面显示该组件的用途说明和 Examples 区域，首个实时示例含 Basic Accordion 标题、说明文字与展开项。 把整套组件源码拷进你项目的 UI kit，配一个 AG Context Generator 让 AI 助手读到真实的 prop 类型与导入路径。
description.en: 把整套组件源码拷进你项目的 UI kit，配一个 AG Context Generator 让 AI 助手读到真实的 prop 类型与导入路径。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by AgnosticUI (https://www.agnosticui.com/).
Technology stack: react, vue, svelte, typescript.
Component specification: Accordion 页面显示该组件的用途说明和 Examples 区域，首个实时示例含 Basic Accordion 标题、说明文字与展开项。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏是一块浅薄荷渐变，中间 AgnosticUI Local 用蓝色、The AI-native UI kit 用黑色大字压着，正文写 Local source lives in your codebase. Our AG Context Generator arms your favorite LLM with exact component locations, types, and usage.，紧接着把 Claude. Codex. Copilot. Gemini. 四个名字排成一句。往下一段白底写 Get Started in Seconds / Three commands and your agent of choice knows your entire stack.，配一个终端窗口，里面跑 npx agnosticui-cli i 并逐行打勾 Installing AgnosticUI components... 与 Components ready in src/components/ag/。再往下是 Get Agent-Ready in 3 Steps、Local Components（React, Vue, Lit, Svelte, Solid, and more）、Arm Your Agent（Run ag context once…Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini），以及一张项目结构图，标出 src/components/ag/ 下是自己项目里的 Button.vue、Card.vue、Input.vue。顶栏只有 AgnosticUI、Components、主题开关和一个 GitHub 图标。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
